added.summary: Opt-in logarithmic depth bands fitted to the full visible non-sky depth range each drawn frame. A GPU min/max reduction covers every depth pixel; false preserves the existing absolute linear depthBandsNear/depthBandsFar fit without reduction passes.

fixed.summary: Enable visible logarithmic depth fitting in painterly-3d's luminous-layers and minimal-geometric's layered-silhouette, replacing their fixed 60 m and 50 m endpoints so near and middle layers survive in differently scaled scenes. Far separation remains open: geometry in the farthest band still merges; this change does not promise a distinct layer for every distant object. Other banded looks retain their absolute fit.
